notes.title: Star Control / Subspace Style Game - Custom C# .NET Game Engine - Level Editor
notes.notes:
Yargis was built from the ground up with its own Custom C# .NET Game Engine and Level Editor. This gives the game a unique feel and allows the editor to be included in the game download. Great for learning game design or having fun.

Jump Gate Improved
Ability to create custom single player campaings improved

notes.title: Now Available: New Controls
notes.notes:
We heard a great idea from the community on easier controls:
W: is always up on the screen
S: move down on the screen
D: move to the right on the screen
A: left on the screen

Mouse would aim.


What do you think? You can turn off the new controls under Settings > Controls.

notes.title: Yargis - Space Melee - Full Workshop Support
notes.notes:
Yargis - Space Melee allows you and your friends to create levels and game types and upload them into the Steam Workshop. It only takes 2 clicks, and your level will be shared with millions of Steam users!

[list]
[*]You can load your own images
[*]Easily play with others, levels are automatically downloaded
[*]Colorize your walls and 3D items
[*]Play your custom levels over the internet
[/list]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/369040/
